name: Roost Laptop Stand
description: This tiny, beautifully engineered laptop stand saved my neck and back during my years of working and nomading. It might seem costly at first but has probably saved me months, if not years, of physiotherapy. Roost turned any place into my office for the day in 30 seconds. It has made working remotely way more enjoyable. I even remember people asking about it when I used it in public places. I should have asked for a referral link! I still enjoy it occasionally when I work from a cafe, and it's still the best.
